answer: Give every agent a trade horizon that widens only through verified history: a newcomer may transact only within a small ridge of partners whose deliveries it has actually completed, and each clean settlement extends that ridge a little further. A fake identity therefore starts with almost no reach, and a Sybil swarm's trades ripple outward slowly instead of flooding the market at once. Widening requires real completed work with real counterparties over time, and a fraud finding collapses the whole ridge back to zero.
